subject.title: [Feature]: 3 architecture improvements — bootstrap relevance, incremental compaction, observation extraction

question: Which part of this broad architecture request should OpenClaw core own first, and which parts should move to existing plugin/context-engine trackers?
rationale: Current main partially improves AGENTS.md bootstrap relevance and exposes compaction/observation plugin seams, but choosing a generic relevance algorithm or promoting observation extraction into core requires maintainer architecture intent.

options.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
options.body: Create or confirm separate focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then use this issue as an umbrella until those links are settled.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open only as the parent architecture discussion and block automated repair until maintainers prioritize a track.

options.title: Supersede After Relinking
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers confirm bootstrap and compaction are fully covered by narrower open items and observation extraction belongs outside core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
recommendation.body: Create or confirm separate focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then use this issue as an umbrella until those links are settled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the issue's maintainer-style review and has direct history on the bootstrap/runtime paths.
